note: 0.6 dev.51 (Osama, 8 November 2026): the S-300V4, S-300PM and Patriot PAC-2 missiles take every S-400 Triumph missile stat except range: damage, penetration, blast and fuse radius, speed, acceleration, burn time, seeker, launch angle, delays, supply cost and resupply time. Each keeps its own range, name, icon and model. Long missiles copy the S-400 40N6 (ammo 220): 9M82MD, 48N6, 48N6P-01 and MIM-104E GEM+. The S-300V4 small missile 9M83M copies the S-400 small missile 9M96M (ammo 217). Launcher weapons are unchanged (the Patriot keeps its aimed launcher). Not yet run in a game.
